meta.description: Cracks on a disc, like the cuticle of a cap that tears into patches as the cap grows: the value is 1 in a crack and 0 on a patch. Narrow cracks between large patches are a cracked old cap, wide cracks between small patches leave scales on a pale ground. cap_pattern puts it on a cap.

radius.description: Outer radius of the disc, measured along the cap from its axis like the pattern of the gills

spacing.description: How far apart the middles of neighbouring patches are

width.description: How wide the cracks are, 0 = none, the spacing = only small islands of the patches are left. Read from the axis (alpha 0) to the edge of the disc (alpha 1), so a curve of alpha opens them towards the margin, and a curve of time lets them open as the cap grows.

stretch.description: How much longer the patches are along the radius than around the axis: 1 = round, over 1 = long patches that run outward like fibrils, under 1 = patches in rings around the axis

softness.description: How softly a crack goes over into its patches: 0 = sharp edges like a dry crust, 1 = patches that round off from their middle like soft scales
